constants.purpose: Centralize repeated scalar values, arrays and complete configuration fragments.
constants.name_rule: Use JavaScript-style identifier names. A dot is reserved for nested property traversal and is not allowed inside a top-level constant name.
constants.ref_semantics: ref() is a whole-value expression. Scalars are inserted directly; objects/arrays are deep-cloned so separate ref() uses are independent.
constants.ref_limits: Every dot-path segment must be an identifier. Array indexing such as ref(items[0].value) is not supported.
constants.calc_scope: Numeric top-level constants and nested numeric object paths already available in declaration order.
constants.declaration_order: Later constants may calculate from earlier numeric constants/namespaces. Do not depend on a later constant or on the object currently being built.
constants.complete_value_only: Neither ref() nor calc() performs string interpolation; the complete configured value must be the expression.

coordinate_system.name: FHS logical coordinate system
coordinate_system.standard_card: A 1/1 card is authored as a 100 x 100 logical canvas.
coordinate_system.origin: 0,0 is the top-left of the logical card; x grows right and y grows down.
coordinate_system.internal_svg: The runtime base SVG dimension is 200. Normal logical dimensions are converted with logical/100*200, so 1 logical unit = 2 internal SVG units.
coordinate_system.aspectratio: Aspect ratio multiplies the reference dimensions. 2/1 yields a 400 x 200 internal SVG viewBox, corresponding to a 200 x 100 logical canvas.

examples.description: Place an item one quarter from the left and halfway down

typography.rule: For normal FHS text, 1em corresponds to approximately 6 logical units on the standard 100-unit card; 2em is approximately 12 logical units.
typography.warning: CSS/em font sizes are not raw FHS width/height numbers. Do not interpret 1em as 1 logical unit.

dimension_spaces.fhs-logical: Positions and most geometry use the 100-unit logical reference scale.
dimension_spaces.raw-svg: A few legacy fields use internal SVG units directly; those fields are explicitly marked.
dimension_spaces.css-style: CSS/SVG style properties such as font-size and stroke-width use their own style semantics.
dimension_spaces.degrees: Rotation and angular path values are expressed in degrees.

reuse.rule: Prefer symbolic layout over repeated literals.
constants_when: the same value or configuration block is used more than once
row items share one y coordinate
column items share one x coordinate
colors, color stops, styles, dimensions, margins, or gaps repeat
reuse.calc_when: Use named start/spacing constants for regular rows, columns, and repeated spacing.
reuse.ref_semantics: A ref() is the referenced value. Inside same_as it replaces that exact inherited path rather than deep-merging with it.
reuse.same_as_semantics: When same_as is present, fields normally required on a standalone item may be inherited and therefore omitted locally.
reuse.delta_semantics: same_as_d<field> is generated only for known numeric/delta-capable fields and accepts a static numeric offset, ref(), or calc().

state_map.purpose: Shared public FHS state-to-display/value mapping contract used by tools that explicitly support state_map.
state_map.note: Entry fields differ by consumer; keep the shared container permissive until the consumer-specific contracts are fully documented.

circles.legacy_radius: Supported for compatibility; legacy radius is raw SVG units. Preserve size with radius_percent = radius / 2.

icon_item_size.context: content.content_horizontal.items[] or content.content_vertical.items[] with type: icon
icon_item_size.meaning: Percentage of the control content cell, converted internally to IconTool icon_size_percent.
icon_item_size.warning: Do not rename this field to icon_size; ControlContent reads item.size.

slider.viz_blocks: show.item_viz selects the matching linear or circular nested configuration.
slider.scale: min/max/step default to bound entity attributes min/max/step and may be explicitly overridden.
slider.single: Runtime creates one internal value binding from slider entity_index.
slider.range: Requires exactly two values; values[0].entity_index becomes the slider primary entity_index.
slider.write_action: set_value_action defaults to local action set-value; custom actions may use value_field/value_fields.

number.contract: Current number control is show.item_variant: stepper + show.item_viz: buttons.
number.local_actions: Default minus/plus use local decrement/increment shorthands translated to bound-domain perform-action. Do not treat them as generic actions.

groups.design_reason: Groups use 50,50 as their local no-offset position so a newly grouped item remains visible at the group center. Authors can design grouped content around the middle instead of around 0,0 where part of it could fall outside the card.
groups.nested_groups: The same 50-centered formula is applied recursively to parent groups.

sizing.icon_size: current font-size-based sizing intended to match text visually
sizing.icon_size_percent: current geometric sizing relative to the SVG/card
sizing.note: Do not replace control content-items[].type=icon size with icon_size; that is a different public interface.

authority.schema: Use the matching fhs.schema.vN.json as the authoritative public FHS syntax/structure contract.
authority.semantics: Use schema description fields for field meaning.
authority.relationships: Use x-fhs-relationships for activation, inheritance, overrides, fallbacks, references and cross-field effects.
authority.internet: Do not replace or mix this contract with syntax inferred from other Home Assistant cards or conflicting internet examples.

existing_cards.rule: Preserve valid existing configuration and make the smallest coherent change required by the user.
existing_cards.reuse: Prefer existing entity bindings, ids, templates, same_as, constants, ref(), calc() and inherited configuration over unnecessary duplication.

color_stops.shared_model: Entity-level color_stops may be consumed by color-stop-aware tools through entity_index when the relevant show mode activates them.
color_stops.preferred_reusable_shape: When the color model includes a shared numeric domain, prefer color_stops.scales.default together with colors so scale and palette travel as one reusable model.
color_stops.compatibility: Compact color-stop mappings/lists remain valid; do not reject them merely because the explicit reusable object form is preferred for authoring.

ai_card_builder.uncertainty: If requested behavior cannot be derived from schema, descriptions, relationships or authoring guidance, say it is not established by the supplied FHS definition instead of inventing a field.
ai_card_builder.design_choices: Clearly distinguish schema/runtime facts from reasonable visual choices such as xpos/ypos, spacing, dimensions and font sizes.

sparkline: Put graph show/family configuration inside layout.sparklines[].sparkline.
Keep period/x_axis/y_axis/series at the sparkline item root.
For explicit series, put graph overrides under series[].sparkline.
runtime_parity_v11.actions: Do not use increment/decrement as generic actions; only number controls translate those local shorthands. Slider set-value is likewise slider-local.
runtime_parity_v11.gradients: Reference layout.gradients with gradient(name), never a raw unscoped url(#name). Numeric objectBoundingBox coordinates/stops use 0..100 percentage semantics.
runtime_parity_v11.constants: Use dotted JavaScript-like paths for nested constants, e.g. ref(theme.colors.warning) and calc(geometry.radius * 2). Dots are traversal separators.

actions.ordered_actions: actions[] executes sequentially in configured order.
actions.target_precedence: Explicit action.entity overrides the bound item/entity target. Otherwise source_entity_index redirects the selected entity when configured.
actions.tap_default: A bound entity with no configured tap action defaults to more-info when that target supports it.

number_control_shorthand.warning: Do not author increment/decrement as generic tap/hold/double-tap actions elsewhere.

slider_shorthand.translation: Translated to perform-action <bound-entity-domain>.set_value with the active slider value.
slider_shorthand.custom_single: For a custom action, value_field gives the target field path receiving the active value.
slider_shorthand.custom_range: value_fields maps target field paths to lower or upper.

hierarchy.graph_block: All graph rendering families and graph show selectors live under sparkline:.

sparklines.duration: Current runtime consumes duration.hour only. Use hour: 24 for one day, not day: 1.
sparklines.chart_type_rule: sparkline.show.chart_type is the primary discriminator and selects sparkline.<chart_type> configuration.

radial.variant_rule: For chart_type radial, sparkline.show.chart_variant must be line, area or dots.
radial.geometry: Configure shared radial geometry at parent sparkline.radial.

radial_barcode.chart_viz: sparkline.show.chart_viz selects interval shape; chart_variant supplies its companion alignment/direction mode.

axes.important: labels/tickmarks/grid do not require show.axis to be true. Each layer is toggled independently.
axes.config_blocks: x_axis and y_axis style/configure available axis layers; they do not enable them.

show.line: Controls the line layer for compatible line/area/radial variants.
show.points: Adds point geometry; line.show_dots and area.show_dots can also activate dots.
show.legend: Activates sparkline.legend and reserves graph area.
show.day_night: Requires calendar/rolling_window; not real_time. Positive future calendar offset is unsupported.
show.area_warning: Do not use show.area. Current runtime selects the area surface through chart_type: area; v10 exposed show.area but runtime does not consume it.

series.nesting: Per-series graph overrides also live under series[].sparkline, not at series root.
series.inheritance: Each explicit series deep-merges over the complete parent sparkline configuration.
series.period_override: A series may override only offset inside the active calendar/rolling_window period branch.
series.radial: Radial series cannot mix with cartesian series; parent chart_type must be radial and shared radial geometry stays on the parent.

show.horseshoe: false removes/filters the gauge tool; true/default activates it.
show.horseshoe_background: Activates horseshoe_background. Defining the background block alone does not show it.
show.tickmarks: Primary tickmark selector. Boolean controls both; {major, minor} controls layers independently.
show.ticks: Legacy fallback only when tickmarks is absent.
show.scale_tickmarks: Legacy compatibility input that can synthesize major tickmarks.

horseshoes.scale_precedence: Explicit horseshoe_scale.min/max override color_stops.scales.default min/max; final fallback is 0..100.
horseshoes.path_rule: path.type selects shape-specific geometry. Keep placement at the horseshoe item level and shape-specific geometry under path.

marker.path: attach_to path defaults to shape circle when icon/shape are absent; size falls back to horseshoe_state.width.
marker.center: attach_to center requires icon and requires path.type arc.
marker.exclusive: icon and shape cannot both be configured.

horseshoes.absolute: Requires scale min <= 0 and max > 0; explicit zero_ratio is invalid.
horseshoes.zero_ratio: bidirectional/bidirectional_symmetrical default to 0.5; otherwise non-absolute modes derive it from scale min/max.
horseshoes.string_state_labels: horseshoe_state.mode stringstate_mode/stringstate_level selects the matching horseshoe_labels sub-block and uses state mapping.

gradients.reference: Use gradient(name) in a style paint property. Do not author raw url(#name); FHS scopes generated SVG ids per card.

numeric_coordinates.userSpaceOnUse: Numbers are normal FHS logical dimensions converted to internal SVG units.

clips.relative: Shape dxpos/dypos makes the definition item-relative and FHS emits an item-specific SVG definition.

masks.reference: item.mask may be one name or an array of names.
masks.multiple: Mask arrays are nested in order; each mask constrains the previous result.
masks.layer_order: Masks are applied first, then clip wraps the masked result.
masks.soft_arc: soft_arc.clip references a clip whose first arc supplies geometry; runtime expands it into separate edge and chord fade masks.

x-fhs-authoring-release.purpose: Preferred runtime-parity authoring patterns paired with fhs.schema.v11.json.
